_about: Documented, reviewed exceptions for the differential gate (differential.py). Each entry silences ONE (target, check) deviation because the independent target is KNOWN to legitimately deviate on that point — e.g. a real, reported bug in that target, or a capability the target implements to an older pinned version. An entry needs the target name, the check id, and a substantive reason (with a link/citation where possible). This exists so a genuine target bug can never silently mask one of OUR check bugs: every deviation is either resolved (fix the check or the target) or explained here. An empty allow list is the healthy default — it means every check agrees with every independent conformant target we test. SELF-EXPIRY (differential.py classify_allowlist, mirroring known_reference_defects.json / known_fuzz_defects.json): each entry is an ACTIVE claim that its (target, check) deviation STILL occurs. If we PROBE the entry's target this run but its silenced deviation NO LONGER occurs (upstream fixed the bug, or our check changed), the entry is STALE and the differential gate FAILS naming it to delete — so a documented silence can never outlive its deviation and thereby mask a FUTURE, different regression of the same (target, check). An entry whose target is not probed this run is untestable and left alone.

allow.reason: GENUINE NODE-REFERENCE BUG, not a check bug. CHK-050 (pinned ucp v2026-04-08 @ a2d8bf0, checkout-rest.md#L1273): 'Protocol errors: Return appropriate HTTP status code (401, 403, 409, 429, 503) with JSON body containing `code` and `content`.' Re-verified on the wire with an idempotency-key conflict (same Idempotency-Key, different create body). NODE returns the CORRECT status 409 but body {"detail":"Idempotency key reused with different parameters"} — NO `code`, NO `content`, and no messages[] error entry carrying them (samples/rest/nodejs/src/api/checkout.ts:509-512 at pin 52377503 emits c.json({detail:...}, 409); update path twin at :650-653). The PYTHON GOLDEN returns 409 with the conformant envelope {"ucp":{"version":"2026-04-08","status":"error"},"messages":[{"type":"error","code":"IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT","content":"Idempotency key reused with different parameters","severity":"unrecoverable"}]} — code+content present (server/exceptions.py:69-79 IdempotencyConflictError). The check is PLACEMENT-PERMISSIVE (accepts code+content at the top level OR inside a messages[] error entry) and value-strict, i.e. generous to servers; Node fails even that generous reading, so this is not a check misread. Only the Node reference deviates — flat-`detail`-shape class; RE-VERIFIED STILL DEVIATING on the wire at the 2026-08-11 re-pin (samples 52377503): 409 {"detail":"Idempotency key reused with different parameters"}, untouched by samples#168 (which fixed only the class's DISC-003/PAY-003 siblings, both entries since expired+removed). Fix drafted, pending owner go before filing under vishkaty per the ucp-upstream-work protocol.

GENUINE NODE-REFERENCE BUG, not a check bug. CHK-053 (pinned ucp v2026-04-08 @ a2d8bf0, checkout.md#L141-145; restated checkout-rest.md#L1317-1333): 'When the business cannot create a new resource or the requested resource no longer exists, the response contains `ucp.status: "error"` with `messages` describing the failure — no resource is included in the response body.' Re-verified on the wire with a create where every line is the seeded zero-stock product (gardenias). NODE returns HTTP 400 body {"detail":"Insufficient stock for item gardenias"} — NO ucp envelope, NO ucp.status:'error', NO messages[] (samples/rest/nodejs/src/api/checkout.ts:489-494 at pin 52377503 validateInventory throws, caught at :618-621 → c.json({detail:e.message}, 400)). The PYTHON GOLDEN returns the conformant {"ucp":{"version":"2026-04-08","status":"error"},"messages":[{"type":"error","code":"OUT_OF_STOCK","content":"Insufficient stock for item gardenias","severity":"unrecoverable"}]} and SELF-TESTS exactly this (server/integration_test.py:345-349 asserts status 400 + ucp.status=='error' + 'Insufficient stock' message; server/exceptions.py:95-105 OutOfStockError). The check asserts the ENVELOPE discriminator (ucp.status:'error' + a type:'error' message + no resource body), NOT an HTTP status — the HTTP-200 business-outcome obligation is CHK-051's separate config-gated row (the reference, and even the golden, still answers 400 here), so the check is not misreading the two-layer 04-08 error model. Only the Node reference deviates — flat-`detail`-shape class; RE-VERIFIED STILL DEVIATING on the wire at the 2026-08-11 re-pin (samples 52377503): 400 {"detail":"Insufficient stock for item gardenias"}, untouched by samples#168 (which fixed only the class's DISC-003/PAY-003 siblings, both entries since expired+removed). Fix drafted, pending owner go before filing under vishkaty per the ucp-upstream-work protocol.
